sources.name: Prosple / GradAustralia
sources.access_method: Server-rendered HTML search pages (paginate with start=), then each detail page's JSON-LD JobPosting

params.keywords: free text, e.g. engineering, electrical engineering, mechatronics, embedded
params.study_fields: numeric taxonomy IDs; 502 = IT & Computer Science (verified); the engineering IDs are unknown (498 returned 0 results). Use keywords= instead
params.start: offset in steps of 20 (verified: start=20 returns items 21-40)
params.recency: no recency filter; dedupe on opportunity URL

sources.response_format: text/html (SSR). Detail pages embed <script type='application/ld+json'> JobPosting

field_map.title: card link text; title suffix in parentheses = intake e.g. '(Nov 2026)', '(Rolling Intake)', '(Start ASAP)'
field_map.company: employer name text in card (also employer slug in URL)
field_map.closing_text: 'Closing in N days|months' / 'Opening in N months' (relative; convert against fetch time)
field_map.detail.jsonld: JobPosting: title, hiringOrganization.name, jobLocation, validThrough (closing date, verified 2026-10-16 for AECOM), baseSalary.value (verified 38 AUD/HOUR), employmentType, datePosted (may be absent)
field_map.apply_url: detail page links to /sign-up?url=<base64 ATS URL>; decode the base64 'url' param to get the employer ATS link (do not follow the sign-up flow)

sources.fallback: Claude sweep: site:au.prosple.com/graduate-employers jobs-internships engineering
sources.notes: gradaustralia.com.au/search-jobs 302-redirects to au.prosple.com (verified), so treat as ONE source. robots.txt allows /search-jobs and detail pages; it disallows /sign-up/, /apply-direct/, /node/*, /graduate-employers*study_fields=. Most CSS classes are hashed (styled-components), so key on href patterns and JSON-LD rather than classes. University white-label portals (e.g. careers.business.unsw.edu.au, latrobe-gradcareers.prosple.com) serve the same Prosple data. Filter out paid placement providers: Readygrad, Premium Graduate Placements, CareerDC, Gradability, The Intern Group, Australian Internships, Ace Talent Recruitment. Local curl from the research sandbox was denied by the org egress policy for every job host (not representative of a GitHub Actions runner); verification was done via WebFetch on 2026-10-06.

sources.name: GradConnection (now 'SEEK Grad')
sources.access_method: Server-rendered HTML listing pages by discipline/location, paginated with ?page=N; detail pages for exact closing date

params.discipline: engineering | engineering-electrical | engineering-mechanical | engineering-civil-structural | engineering-geotechnical (verified); likely also engineering-mechatronics, engineering-software, engineering-aerospace, engineering-chemical, engineering-mining (unverified)
params.location: australia (verified) | sydney | melbourne | brisbane | perth | adelaide | canberra | mackay ...
params.page: 1-based, 20 per page; header text 'X - Y of Z results' (verified: engineering/australia = 103, electrical = 50, mechanical = 44)

sources.response_format: text/html (SSR; no __NEXT_DATA__ and no JSON-LD on detail pages)

field_map.card_link: a[href^='/employers/'][href*='/jobs/'] -> '/employers/{employer}/jobs/{slug}/' (real jobs); '/employers/{employer}/notifyme/{slug}/' = 'Notify Me' placeholders (route to expected[], not open[])
field_map.title: card title link text
field_map.company: employer name text in card (also URL segment 1)
field_map.location: location text, e.g. 'Sydney' or 'Multiple (13 locations)' (detail page has the full list)
field_map.closing_text: 'Closing in N days' | 'Closing in a month' | 'New!' | 'Open'
field_map.detail.closing: exact, e.g. '7th November 2026, 12:59 pm' (verified on the Lucid page)
